title: Digital Glitch
description: Occasional horizontal block displacement and color misalignment.

uniforms.name: intensity
uniforms.label: Intensity
uniforms.description: Blend with the original image. Zero bypasses this layer.

uniforms.name: frequency
uniforms.label: Frequency
uniforms.description: How often local glitches appear; zero stops new glitches.

uniforms.name: displacement
uniforms.label: Displacement
uniforms.description: Bounded horizontal displacement of affected blocks.

uniforms.name: blockSize
uniforms.label: Block size
uniforms.description: Height of each glitch band in physical pixels.
